decision_record.question: Is this object Lead, Opportunity, Solution, or Case?
decision_record.answer: Case — but this step writes no RecordType, so the businessProcess rule does not apply here. M1-S01 already satisfied it: both record types name a business process.
decision_record.element: none in this step; recorded so the checker's four-object rule is visibly accounted for

decision_record.question: Which profile does each affected user actually hold?
decision_record.answer: Q3: three profiles matching Tier 1, Tier 2 and Billing, each with an explicit default record type and layout assignment.
decision_record.element: No element in this step. layoutAssignments and recordTypeVisibilities live only on Profile (metadata-examples.md, 'Making the record type visible and assigning the page'), and Profile is M2's. The layout file-name forms the M2 step must use are recorded in deploy-order.md instead.

decision_record.question: Is a field being marked Required on the layout meant to be enforced everywhere?
decision_record.answer: Q5: no. Priority and Origin are enforced at field or validation-rule level because Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case create through the API, where layout Required does not bind (gotchas #11).
decision_record.element: Every layoutItems/behavior on both layouts is Edit or Readonly; no Required anywhere. This is what produces the checker's two INFO findings, which are the correct output for this design.

decision_record.question: How do Cases arrive: web form, email, UI, API, Data Loader, Flow?
decision_record.answer: Q24: Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case invoke the assignment rule by default; manual UI creation (~20/day) needs the checkbox defaulted on for the Case layouts.
decision_record.element: <showRunAssignmentRulesCheckbox>true</showRunAssignmentRulesCheckbox> on both layouts — metadata-examples.md line 198, allowed on Case, Lead and Account (line 210). The 'defaulted on' half has no element in the inventory and was not written; see dimensions_skipped.

decision_record.question: Which UI does each persona actually use — Lightning desktop, the mobile app, or Classic?
decision_record.answer: Q83: Lightning desktop for all three teams; no mobile requirement in this phase.
decision_record.element: No element. Confirms a classic Layout is the right artefact and that no FlexiPage or formFactor override is in scope for this step.

decision_record.question: Which fields must a validation rule be able to attach its error to? (assumption A13)
decision_record.answer: M3-S01 declares two rules, Priority_Required_On_Agent_Save and Origin_Must_Be_Known. Both Priority and Origin are placed on both layouts.
decision_record.source: upstream/downstream step record (M3-S01 outputs[]) and assumption A13
decision_record.element: layoutItems/field Priority and layoutItems/field Origin in the Case Information section of both layouts

decision_record.question: Which picklist values differ between these processes, field by field? (assumption A26)
decision_record.answer: A26: exactly two record types, Support and Billing. Support exposes Origin values Email-Support and Web; Billing exposes Email-Billing. Severity__c is an outage concept and appears on the Support layout only.
decision_record.element: Severity__c present on Case-Case Support Layout, absent from Case-Case Billing Layout

decision_record.question: Which layout sections and style?
decision_record.answer: Two sections, Case Information (customLabel true) and System Information (customLabel false, built-in label), both TwoColumnsTopToBottom with two layoutColumns.
decision_record.source: skill default — the structure of metadata-examples.md's own layout example, adapted per AGENT.md Step 5 rule 3
decision_record.element: layoutSections/style, customLabel, detailHeading, editHeading, layoutColumns, emptySpace
